title: LinkMe File Uploads Need Non-IAB Or Manual Upload Path
summary: Codex in-app browser cannot reliably complete LinkMe file uploads, so ATLAS should prepare upload-safe assets and hand off the final file chooser step to a supported browser or manual path.

metadata.source: live Codex desktop LinkMe setup session

context.goal: Upload custom gothic green/black brand icons to LinkMe featured cards.

metadata.decision: Do not rely on Codex in-app browser automation for LinkMe file uploads. Prepare upload-safe assets in ATLAS, then use a user/manual upload path or a future browser surface that supports file chooser automation.
evidence: Codex in-app browser reported that file uploads are not supported by Codex in-app browser.
Clicking LinkMe's Upload an icon control did not surface a native Windows Open dialog in the window list.
LinkMe exposes hidden file inputs, but the in-app browser blocks supported file chooser automation and CDP file injection.

current_assets.purpose: Custom Workout Setup featured card icon

metadata.workflow_rule: For future Codex LinkMe customization: first save and compress user-provided assets into tmp/linkme-icons, then attempt upload only from a browser/tool surface with file chooser support. If using Codex in-app browser, stop before upload and hand the prepared file paths to the user.
metadata.recommended_execution_path: Codex prepares assets and verifies LinkMe state; user or Chrome/browser surface with file upload support completes the upload.
